text: The framework partitions an input image into regular patches, randomly masking out a large proportion of them.
Only the remaining visible, unmasked patches are collected into a sequence for processing.
These visible patches are passed through a Transformer encoder.
The encoder outputs latent feature representations solely for the visible patches.
The encoded features are combined with learnable mask tokens to restore the full patch sequence.
This complete sequence is processed by a Transformer decoder.
The decoder generates reconstructed pixel predictions for each patch location.
The reconstructed patches form the target output image, which is optimized using a reconstruction loss against the original image.
